title: k8s-node-provisioning-debug-scratchpad
content:
Context:
- Intermittent failures during node boot / join in staging cluster (staging-useast-1). Around 2-5% of new instances get stuck NotReady or never join control plane.
- Triggered after image bump (ubuntu-22.04 + containerd 1.7) + new cloud-init template. Suspect provisioning race or missing systemd unit ordering.

What I tried (commands + immediate findings):
1) k8s-level checks
- kubectl get nodes -o wide
  -> 3 nodes in NotReady, Reason: KubeletNotReady / NetworkUnavailable (varies).
- kubectl describe node ip-10-0-12-34
  -> last heartbeat older than 2m; kubelet stopped posting. No outstanding taints except node.kubernetes.io/not-ready.
- kubectl get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -n 40
  -> repeated errors: "Failed to create cni config" and "NetworkPlugin cni failed" around boot time.

2) SSH + system checks (on problem node)
- journalctl -u kubelet -b | tail -n 200
  -> repeated: "Failed to register node \"ip-10-0-12-34\": node IP not found in any network interface" then "Failed to start Container runtime shim: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: desc = \"transport: authentication handshake failed\""
- sudo systemctl status containerd
  -> Active: failed (Exit code=1/FAILURE). journalctl -u containerd shows: "failed to start: error while loading plugin configuration: /etc/containerd/config.toml: unknown field \"disabled_plugins\"" (weird, config came from image bake)
- cat /var/log/cloud-init-output.log
  -> cloud-init applied but failed to write /etc/containerd/config.toml properly; template render skipped when metadata missing.
- sudo ip a; ip route show
  -> interface device naming: sometimes eni0 -> eth0, but on new ENIs we saw unpredictable eth index. MTU looks consistent.

3) CNI / network diagnostics
- ls /etc/cni/net.d -> empty on a few nodes where kubelet failed early (CNI not installed yet by daemonset?)
- kubectl -n kube-system get pods -l k8s-app=cilium -o wide
  -> cilium-daemonset running on healthy nodes; missing on failed nodes (no pod scheduled because node not registered).
- Check installer: helm release for cilium is applied via GitOps after nodes register. But some nodes need network pre-flight to contact API to get config. Race condition suspected.

4) Terraform / cloud-init / packer traces
- terraform apply logs show cloud-init completed with exit code 0 (per cloud provider), but cloud-init-output contains template errors.
- Packer image bake changed containerd default config (introduced disabled_plugins), not supported by our containerd runtime (1.7 minor mismatch).

Error snippets seen:
- "Failed to register node \"ip-10-0-12-34\": node IP not found in any network interface"
- "containerd: error while loading plugin configuration: unknown field \"disabled_plugins\""
- "CNI plugin not found: no config files in /etc/cni/net.d"
- kubeadm join errors (on some repros): "this node's certificate has expired" (older token repro)

Hypotheses / prioritized causes:
1) Image/config mismatch: new image contains containerd config fields not supported by our packaged containerd -> containerd fails, kubelet can't start -> node never registers.
2) Race between cloud-init and kubelet/cni install: kubelet starts before CNI and container runtime are fully configured -> kubelet reports NetworkPlugin cni failed and node NotReady.
3) Instance metadata / network interface renaming creates transient condition where kubelet cannot locate primary IP at startup.
4) GitOps ordering: cilium/daemonset expected to run after node-register; but some setup requires CNI present earlier (we rely on host preinstall).

Immediate next steps (tests to run):
- Create repro AMI with containerd config pinned to containerd 1.7 expected schema; bake and spin one instance to validate containerd starts clean.
- Force kubelet to delay start until containerd+network present: add systemd unit drop-in for kubelet (ExecStartPre check loop) and test on staging.
- Temporarily change cloud-init to write a sentinel file /var/lib/cloud-init-done when containerd config written; kubelet unit should check for it.
- Re-run packer build with same variables, and diff /etc/containerd/config.toml between old and new images.
- Add additional logging to cloud-init template to fail loudly if metadata is missing (so we don't silently skip fields).

Collecting logs for postmortem (commands to run on failing node):
- sudo journalctl -u kubelet -b > /tmp/kubelet-journal.log
- sudo journalctl -u containerd -b > /tmp/containerd-journal.log
- sudo cat /etc/containerd/config.toml > /tmp/containerd-config.toml
- sudo ls -al /etc/cni/net.d > /tmp/cni-listing.txt
- sudo cat /var/log/cloud-init-output.log > /tmp/cloud-init-output.log
- tar czf /tmp/node-debug-logs-$(hostname)-$(date +%F).tgz /tmp/kubelet-journal.log /tmp/containerd-journal.log /tmp/containerd-config.toml /tmp/cni-listing.txt /tmp/cloud-init-output.log
- aws s3 cp /tmp/node-debug-logs-$(hostname)-$(date +F).tgz s3://redwood-infra-debug-uploads/

Notes / heuristics observed:
- Most failures are in first 90s of boot; nodes that make it past 2m almost always become Ready. Suggests startup race.
- The unknown field "disabled_plugins" is from packer image; downgrading packer template to previous commit fixed for one repro.
- 1 node showed TLS handshake failure between kubelet and API: time skew (ntpd not started early enough) -> ensure ntp service runs earlier.

To-dos / assignments:
- (Avery) Bake repro AMI with containerd config pinned, test in staging. Target: 2026-02-05.
- (Samir) Add kubelet systemd ExecStartPre check for /var/run/containerd.sock; test.
- (Lina) Update cloud-init template to log/render errors and create sentinel file on completion.
- (Ethan) Open INFRA-3421 with steps, attach tar logs, link PR for temporary kubelet delay.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Do we want to push a quick rollback of the image until packer/template is fixed? (Safer but delays other fixes)
- Is there any dependency that requires CNI preinstalled on host (we assume daemonset, but docs say host-local is ok). Need to confirm with CNI vendor notes.
- Should we enforce kubelet start-after=containerd in systemd unit across fleet? Risk: if containerd fails, kubelet won't start and might prevent auto-recovery; but it's safer for consistent state.

Scratch commands (copy/paste):
- kubectl get nodes -o wide
- kubectl describe node ip-10-0-12-34
- kubectl -n kube-system logs ds/cilium -l k8s-app=cilium --tail=200
- ssh ubuntu@ip-10-0-12-34 "sudo journalctl -u kubelet -b | tail -n 500"
- ssh ubuntu@ip-10-0-12-34 "sudo cat /etc/containerd/config.toml"
- sudo journalctl -u containerd -b | sed -n '1,200p'
- grep -nR "disabled_plugins" / -I || true

History notes:
- 2026-01-15: Start of investigation (image bump rolled 2026-01-14)
- 2026-01-20: Confirmed containerd config mismatch on 2/5 failing nodes
- 2026-02-02: Temporary mitigation tested (kubelet delay) on 1 repro node -> success
- 2026-02-20: Continuing with AMI rebuild + template fixes.

Comments: keep this doc as scratchpad, move cleaned postmortem to Confluence when we have final root cause and rollout plan.
